The Opportunity:
Joii offers secure, well-paid positions with the added bonus that what you do will make a difference in our community. 

Due to a long, strong, and ongoing pipeline of work we are ungently seeking enthusiastic and motivated applicants for the positions of qualified Motor Mechanic within our Queensland Trades Team who will work for our valued clients.  

Essential skills needed:
•	Qualification as a Motor Mechanic.
•	Qualification as Electric Vehicle Motor Mechanic an advantage

•	Hold all industry required tickets and tools.
•	Supply & maintain own commercial grade tools, noting a tool maintenance allowance is included in the salary package)

•	Maintain current driver’s license.

About You:
•	Able to work unsupervised and part of a team.
•	Able to follow instructions.
•	Hard working and reliable.
•	Attention to detail and able to work to deadlines.

What you need to do now
If you are interested and have the experience, we would love to hear from you!

Please click the 'APPLY' button now and send through your resume and cover letter detailing your previous relevant experience and why you are the perfect candidate for our team.

Please note, due to the high number of applications we expect to receive, we will only be responding to applicants who have been successful in securing an interview.

Price Trandos Engineering

Positions: Electrical Engineer, Electrical Engineering Design Draftsperson, Electrical Engineering Technician & Electronic Equipment Trades Worker

Wangara WA

Full-time


P&T Industries Pty Ltd is a leading Switchboard Manufacturing Company operating out of Perth, Western Australia, carrying out engineering, design and drafting, manufacture, testing and delivery of a complete range of products both within Australia and internationally.


We are currently looking for a skilled and experienced Electrical Engineer, Electrical Engineering Design Draftsperson, Electrical Engineering Technician & Electronic Equipment Trades Worker to join our team. These are permanent, full-time positions.


Electrical Engineer

*Duties & Responsibilities

•	Planning, designing, programming power monitoring systems and equipment

•	Preparing drawings, plans and diagrams of electrical installations and circuitry

•	Design verification to A61439

•	Conducting discrimination studies

•	Collecting data, performing tests and complex calculations, graphing results, and preparing charts and tabulations estimating materials costs and quantities

•	Inspecting designs and finished products for compliance with specifications and regulations

•	Assembling, installing, testing, calibrating, modifying, and repairing electrical equipment and installations to conform with regulations and safety requirements.

•	Undertaking electrical workshop functions such as installing assemblies for protection relays, metering and indicating devices


*Must have requirements:

•	"A" Grade electrical license is preferred

•	Knowledge on BMS and Power Management Software

•	Switchboard manufacturing experience and a sound knowledge of Australian standards

•	Experience with control wiring and fault finding

•	Good communication and interpersonal skills

•	High regard for safety and a healthy working environment


Salary Range: $79,499 to $95,000


Electrical Engineering Draftsperson

*Duties and Responsibilities

•	Planning, designing, programming power monitoring systems and equipment

•	Preparing drawings, plans and diagrams of electrical installations and circuitry

•	Uses software in created technical drawings and plans for electrical system

•	Design verification to AS61439

•	Conducting discrimination studies

•	Assisting Electrical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in design and layout of electrical installations and circuitry on substations, switchgear, cabling systems and motor control systems

•	Coordinating with the Engineer for the created design into a blueprint and to ensure that they meet the requirements.

•	Collecting data, performing tests and complex calculations, graphing results, and preparing charts and tabulations estimating materials costs and quantities

•	Inspecting designs and finished products for compliance with specifications and regulations

•	Assembling, installing, testing, calibrating, modifying, and repairing electrical equipment and installations to conform with regulations and safety requirements

•	Undertaking electrical workshop functions such as installing assemblies for protection relays, metering and indicating devices

•	Assisting with research and experimentation programs

*Skills and Experience Required:

•	Must have minimum of 3 years working experience in the industry

•	Good communication and interpersonal skills

•	Attention to details

•	High regard for safety and a healthy working environment


Salary Range: $79,499 to $95,000


Electrical Engineering Technician

*Duties & Responsibilities:

•	Read and understand and interpret wiring SLD's and Switchboard drawing layout.

•	Understand Australian Standards and apply knowledge on Switchboard manufacturing and assembly.

•	Assisting Electrical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in design and layout of electrical installations and circuitry on substations, switchgear, cabling systems and motor control systems.

•	Inspecting designs and finished products for compliance with specifications and regulations.

•	Manufacture and assembly of electrical switchboards, motor control centres, and sub-station kiosks.


-	Busbar bending, cutting and punching
-	Laying out electrical componentry (ACB's, MCCB's, chassis, RCD's, Meters) on switchboards
-	Wiring electrical equipment at our factory

*Must have requirements:

•	LV Switchboard manufacturing and assembly experience

•	Ability to use basic hand tools


*Ideal requirements:

•	Use of busbar machinery and equipment

•	Electrical license

•	Experience with control wiring and fault finding


Salary range: $79,499 to $95,000


Electronic Equipment Trades Worker

*Duties & Responsibilities:

•	Conduct comprehensive examinations and tests on machines, equipment, instruments, and control systems to accurately identify faults.

•	Proactively adjust, repair, and replace worn or defective parts and wiring to ensure optimal maintenance of machinery and equipment.

•	Reassemble and test equipment, implementing necessary adjustments to enhance overall performance.

•	Provide users with clear and precise guidance on correct operating procedures to prevent malfunctions effectively.

•	Skillfully interpret coded messages, translating them into plain language to facilitate effective communication through well-documented transmissions.

•	Monitor radio traffic efficiently to guarantee accurate transmission and reception of voice messages.

•	Expertly install electronic instruments and control systems to enhance functionality.

*Must have:

•	At least three years of relevant experience for this position.


Salary range: $79,499 to $95,000


If these positions sound like something you are interested in, please forward your resume to russel@pricetrandos.com.au

result.description:
Eyria Investments is a leading Tourist, Holiday and Private accommodation provider in Port Lincoln South Australia. Facilities include Bed & Breakfast properties, Worker Accommodation, Tourist Accommodation (RV & Cabins) and private rental properties. 
Eyria are looking fulfil five (5) positions on a Fulltime basis.

Approximate Start date: September 2026

JOB SUMMARY:
Successful applicants will need to perform the following Duties.
•	Cleaning/Housekeeping of all Tourist Park cabins and sites as per the cleaning guidelines
•	Cleaning of Amenity Blocks at the Tourist Park
•	Cleaning of Guest laundry facilities at the Tourist Park
•	Laundering of Linen/Manchester utilising onsite commercial machines 
•	Liaise with reception/administration staff at the Tourist Park regarding customer requirements.
•	General duties as required or advised by the Park Manager/Park Supervisor
•	Cleaning/Housekeeping of all Eyria Investments apartment accommodation
•	Cleaning off site for other contracted locations
•	Ensure a friendly nature to all guests at Eyria Investments properties
•	Cleaning of Worker Accommodation Facilities leased from Eyria Investments

Operational Hours:
Facilities are operating 7 days per week all year and facilities require continuous service.
Typical hours are: 38 hours per week 7am – 3:30pm on a rotating 7 day roster. Successful candidates can expect to work any 5 days of the 7 day week.
(There may be requirements to perform after hours tasks)
This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.
REMUNERATION:
Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Work completed at all sites will be calculated at the applicable hourly Award Rate. Penalty and overtime rate will be applied where applicable. (https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000009.html)
INDUCTION & TRAINING:
•	All staff to be inducted to all sites
•	Safety drills conducted bi-monthly
•	Machinery and equipment training and assessment  
•	SOP’s to be discussed for operations 
•	Chemical use and hazard training

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.
